title.en: Comey charged with threatening Trump's life in Instagram post

reflection.en: This case highlights the complexities of interpreting public communications and the legal boundaries of free expression, particularly when allegations of threats arise. It underscores the importance of upholding principles of justice and accountability in legal proceedings,...
